values.title: Why Families Trust Elamel
values.card1Desc: All mineral glazes and paints comply strictly with European EN71-3 and ASTM D-4236 standards, 100% free of lead, cadmium, and harmful VOCs.

values.card3Desc: Every kit features easy-grip handles and visual guides, making it easy for both grandparents and toddlers to create art without frustration.

about.heroTitle: Crafting Colors, Baking Joy, Celebrating Families
about.heroLead: elamel was born around a simple kitchen table with a heartfelt belief: that the most cherished family memories happen when hands are making art and families are gathered around wholesome treats.
about.studioTag: A Home for Every Generation • Pottery Studio & Bakery Under One Roof
about.storyHeading: Our Story: From the Kitchen Table to Your Home
about.storyP1: Elamel emerged from the union of traditional ceramic arts and wholesome artisanal baking. We noticed a lack of truly engaging activities that connected grandparents, parents, and children without digital screens.
about.storyP2: We set out to create silky porcelain bisque and non-toxic mineral glazes that anyone can paint at home, alongside cakes and biscuits that taste like childhood comfort.
about.safetyHeading: Unwavering Commitment to Safety & Allergen Transparency
about.safetyLead: Parents' peace of mind is our highest priority. Every step of our craft and baking process is designed for child safety.
about.safetyPoint1Desc: Certified under the strictest European standards for food contact safety and children's toys.
about.safetyPoint2Desc: Our bakery operates with strict separation protocols to eliminate nut cross-contamination.
about.safetyPoint3Desc: Mugs and plates shaped for easy gripping by both toddler hands and elderly joint comfort.
about.workshopsSubtitle: Visit our welcoming Porto studio for combined pottery painting and fresh pastry tasting sessions.
